leadText:
This is the second chapter of the Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master! manga. It was first published in the February 2021 issue of CoroCoro Ichiban!, released on December 21, 2020. It is 18 pages long.

It was made available on CoroCoro Online on November 18, 2021 and on Weekly CoroCoro Comics on July 15, 2022.
